stories.title: Man who fled to Ecuador to avoid prosecution brought back to Texas after 8 years, GCSO says
stories.summary: The Galveston County Sheriff's Office said Frank Edward Cole fled the U.S. while out on bond for a family violence charge eight years ago.

stories.title: Texas flu cases climb as doctors warn of an early holiday surge
stories.summary: Flu cases are climbing across Texas as a mutated H1N1 strain spreads. Houston doctors are urging residents to get vaccinated ahead of the holidays.

stories.title: More than 1,500 bills filed in Texas. Here's what happens next
stories.summary: More than 1,500 bills have been filed ahead of Texas' 2027 legislative session. Here's how proposals become law and why many never advance.

stories.title: 8-month-old accidentally shot inside northwest Harris County apartment, deputies say
stories.summary: An 8-month-old is expected to survive after being accidentally shot by the child's father at a Harris County apartment, according to investigators.

stories.title: Robert Bond vanished from a Houston townhome in 2024. His family fears he'll never come home
stories.summary: Robert Bond disappeared from a Galleria-area townhome in June 2024. His mother says the family has slowly come to believe he is dead.

stories.title: Pct. 6 constable's office employee involved in deadly road rage shooting on Highway 90, HCSO says
stories.summary: A 35-year-old man was shot and killed during a road rage incident on Highway 90 in Crosby. HCSO says the shooter works for a constable's office.

stories.title: Driver caught after fleeing deadly southwest Houston crash, police say
stories.summary: Police said the Jeep’s driver ran from the scene and was apprehended. The 20-year-old SUV driver died at the scene.

stories.title: Crash clears hours after shutting down outbound lanes of Eastex Freeway in Humble area
Deadly shooting at Katy-area Airbnb prompts new security measures, concerns from neighbors
stories.summary: One man was killed and another injured during a party at a short-term rental in the Windstone Colony neighborhood.

stories.title: Houston's Pancho Claus remains hospitalized as doctors investigate possible brain mass
stories.summary: Houston's Pancho Claus remains hospitalized as doctors investigate a possible brain mass. Despite his health concerns, he's focused on helping children.

stories.title: Man accused of killing girlfriend with U-Haul held without bond
stories.summary: Bobby Joe McCullah Jr. is being held without bond on a murder charge in the death of his girlfriend, Amber Mauceli, who was struck by a U-Haul.

stories.title: Dogs responsible for killing 3 animals at Houston-area high school barn, district says
stories.summary: Dogs killed a goat and two pigs belonging to Aldine students at a shared school barn. The district said it is strengthening security.
